name: novabox
description: Local, auditable toolbox for data transforms, calculations, text cleanup, regex tests and reusable workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run local, reusable tools beside Codex
interface.longDescription: Novabox is a local toolbox that turns repeated data work into constrained, testable tools. It searches the installed tool library, runs the matching tool with exact inputs, and opens the result in a companion panel beside Codex.
defaultPrompt: 用 Novabox 整理这段文本并去重
